sections.project_overview: A unique, state-of-the-art development exclusively for those aged 55 and over, set within 27 acres of beautiful parkland and lakes.
sections.design: It combines newly constructed buildings with restored Grade II listed structures to create a bespoke residential environment.

phase_1_2_highlights.description: Exceptional collection of 1 and 2-bedroom luxury apartments across several buildings.

community_hub.purpose: Vibrant heart of the village offering wellness and social engagement.

sections.phase_3_expansion: Additional 1 and 2-bedroom apartments and a lodge to meet growing demand for high-quality later living.
